name: ticker_key
description: Surrogate primary key for financial instrument (e.g. EQUITY#AAPL)

name: ticker
description: Financial instrument symbol or ticker (e.g. AAPL, EURUSD, BTCUSD)

name: ticker_name
description: Descriptive legal name of financial instrument or asset

name: asset_class
description: Asset class classification: EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, CRYPTO, ETF

name: exchange
description: Primary trading exchange or venue (e.g. NASDAQ, NYSE, CME, BINANCE, FOREX)

name: currency
description: Trading quoting currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

name: sector
description: Macro industry sector (e.g. Technology, Financials, Energy)

name: industry
description: Sub-industry classification (e.g. Consumer Electronics, Investment Banking)

name: is_active
description: Flag indicating if instrument is currently active for trading

name: valid_to
description: SCD Type 2 validity end timestamp (NULL if current)

name: created_at
description: Audit timestamp when record was created in DWH

name: updated_at
description: Audit timestamp when record was last updated in DWH
